title: BeautyRestart
body:
# Simple server restart plugin with timer and HEX color support
**⚠️To run this plugin you must also install the [ForestCore](https://modrinth.com/plugin/forestcore) plugin on your server.**
## Why BeautyRestart?
- HEX color support
- ForestCore support
- Customizable `config.yml` with default timer
- `/brest reload` command
### Run `/brest go [time in seconds]` for start the timer
